title: Form 2 Biology — Photosynthesis
subject: Biology

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Good morning class. Today we are learning about photosynthesis.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Photosynthesis is how green plants make their own food.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: They use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Chlorophyll in the leaf traps light energy.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: The plant produces glucose and releases oxygen.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Look at the maize leaf on the board. This is where most photosynthesis happens.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Chlorophyll is the green pigment inside the leaf cells.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Energy from sunlight is stored in glucose as chemical energy.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Will this be examined? Yes. Photosynthesis is a core Form 2 topic.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Write the word equation in your books, then we will revise together.

suggestedQuestions: What is the role of chlorophyll?
Can you repeat the last definition?
